name: regina_referral_mining
cadence_note: Operator-pull, ~5/wk over ~9 weeks until the 5-star reviewer pool is exhausted.
description: Ask 5-star reviewers if they know anyone who'd love the property. Specific over generic.
prompt_context: This guest left a 5-star review. Ask if they know anyone who'd love the property — wedding planners, friends planning a milestone, group trips. Be specific about the kind of trip La Puesta excels at (private buyouts, weddings, multi-generational family reunions) so the ask isn't generic. Keep under 120 words. Sign as Sarah.
